description_expanded:
This beautiful condominium is new to the Alys Beach Rental program. It features balconies facing South over Highway 30A and East overlooking the emerging Alys Beach Town Center and the Amphitheatre. Guests will find this the perfect location to enjoy afternoon sunsets over the Gulf of Mexico or the many events held in the Amphitheatre. The open-plan family room provides plenty of seating. The kitchen is open to the family room and features a large center island and a butler’s pantry for extra room and storage. A set of bunk beds in a private alcove offers additional sleeping areas. A king bedroom shares a full bath with the bunks. The primary bedroom suite offers a king-sized bed and spacious bath with a large, walk-in shower. Parking for this vacation rental is one designated space in a parking garage beneath the building. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
